repos.name: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
repos.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
repos.one_liner: A collection of open-source plugins designed to extend the capabilities of Claude for knowledge workers.
bullets: Built using Python to integrate seamlessly with Claude's agentic workflows.
Focuses on automating complex knowledge-based tasks and data processing.
Provides a standardized framework for building custom AI-driven productivity tools.
Ideal for professionals looking to integrate LLMs into their daily research and documentation pipelines.

repos.name: mhtsec/ARTEX
repos.description: AI 自主渗透测试系统 | 百度“agent+”攻防挑战赛冠军项目
repos.one_liner: An autonomous AI-driven penetration testing system designed for security research and defense.
bullets: Developed in Go, leveraging agentic workflows for automated vulnerability assessment.
Winner of the Baidu 'Agent+' security challenge, demonstrating high-level autonomous reasoning.
Automates the discovery and exploitation lifecycle, reducing manual security audit overhead.
Useful for fintech security teams to proactively identify infrastructure vulnerabilities.

repos.name: zhongerxin/iPhone-use
repos.description: 让 Codex 通过 USB 操作真实 iPhone：引导安装、App 自动化、实时屏幕与截图回退。
repos.one_liner: A framework that enables LLMs to control physical iPhones via USB for automation and testing.
bullets: Uses Python to bridge Codex/LLMs with iOS device interfaces via USB.
Supports real-time screen monitoring, automated app interaction, and screenshot-based feedback loops.
Enables agentic control of mobile environments for QA or automated data extraction.
Highly relevant for mobile-first fintech apps requiring automated regression testing.
